lines: Shizuku playfully laughed as he suddenly disappeared into thin air.
It was his intuition from many years of combat experience that had made him lift the encirclement and have his men disperse.
Most of the Fuma ninja instantly responded to Library's order.
However, one of them, too slow to react, let out a scream of agony.
His body had been sliced up by the energy blades of Shizuku's claws that suddenly appeared behind him.
Tension swelled among the Fuma ninja.
That might be just one aspect of it. Don't assume until you know the true nature of the Ninja Art.
The Oniwaban swiftly took an alert stance.
Shizuku, having finished off one of them, spoke with admiration.
Seems like you have a bit of fighting sense, mister, but I wonder if you can keep up with me?
Shizuku once again disappeared without a trace.
You're not the only one who can hide, boy.
Unlike Shizuku's abrupt disappearance, he faded away as if to blend into the surrounding landscape.
It was the Silicon Jutsuーthat is to say, Library's ability to crystallize his entire body and become optically camouflaged.
『Ahaha! I'm surprised. I wonder what kind of Ninja Arts you use, mister.』
The voice came out of nowhere and in the next instant,
energy claws sprouted from the chest of one of the Fuma ninja.
Shizuku, who'd again appeared from the rear, had stabbed his heart with the claws.
A streak of light ran from the top of Shizuku's shoulder to his back.
The moment Shizuku had attacked his second victim, Library, who'd been waiting for the opening, had appeared and silently swung his blade from behind him.
The swift strike unleashed at the sacrifice of his subordinate's life seemed to definitely cut through Shizuku's body.
But that was not the case.
Part of Shizuku's body had turned into a kind of black liquid,
and Library's blade had just passed through it, causing no damage to Shizuku.
Sensing something strange through his blade, Library leaped back almost at the same time as he struck Shizuku.
Lunging at the fleeing Library, Shizuku unleashed his claws with delight.
Though it had damaged part of his chest, he'd somehow managed to avoid Shizuku's strike.
You too. You've trained quite a bit for one so young.
Shizuku's eyes began to gleam with pride when Library calmly replied.
You seem to be able to hide yourself in something like droplets of black water.
That's right. I call them "Drops of Darkness." It's the power of my Evil Eye, the "Blind Eye of the Crimson Serpent."
What a fearsome ability. I can't let you meet the Master after all, can I?
Ahahaha. I thought you'd say that, mister. But I'd better get going now.
The "Drops of Darkness" welled up from Shizuku's feet.
They crawled up Shizuku's body to cover it as if defying gravity.
At Library's order, the Oniwaban troops threw their kunai in unison.
However, just like when he'd slashed Shizuku before, the "Drops of Darkness" made all the kunai pass through his body.
It was fun fighting with you, old man, but it'll have to wait until next time. So long♪
With those parting words, Shizuku vanished as if he'd been swallowed by his own darkness.
Library immediately split the troops into two groups, one to pursue Shizuku and the other to protect Kotaro.
A gust of wind blew through the grounds.
Nothing was left behind after that, not even the bodies of the slain Fuma ninja.
